page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, no margins with text. Heading at top centre (two lines, title of a book list), then four numbered entries in one column, the last entry's number at the lower right as catchword. No page number, no running head.

main_text.head: LEONIS ALLATII Libri editi in Typographia S. Congregationis Fidei propagandæ.
main_text.p: I.[?] DE ætate, & interstitijs in Collatione Ordinum etiam apud Græcos seruandis, ad Cardinalem FRANCISCVM BRANCACCIVM. addita sunt eiusdem ALLATII Ode Pindarica, & Epigrammata vii. Græca in Assumptam DEIPARAM. 1638. in 8.

II. ORTHODOXAE GRAECIAE Scriptores NICEPHORVS BLEMMIDA, IOANNES VECCVS Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus, PETRVS Episcopus Mediolanensis GREGORIVS PACHYMERES, ESAIAS CYPRIVS, IOANNES ARGYROPYLVS, GREGORIVS Proto-syncellus Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus, GEORGIVS TRAPEZVNTINVS, IOANNES PLVSIADENVS, HILARIO Monachus, De Processione Spiritus sancti a Patre, & Filio. NICETAE BYZANTII Philosophi, & Magistri Refutatio Epistolæ scriptæ ab Armenorum Principe, qua fidem Catholicam, & Chalcedonensem Synodum criminabatur, & alijs. Tomus primus. LEO ALLATIVS nunc primum e tenebris eruit, & Latine vertit, ad Cardinalem ALOYSIVM CAPPONIVM. Addita est, de GREGORIO PALAMA Archiepiscopo Thessalonicensi in numerum Sanctorum a nonnullis Græcis adscito Græcorum[?] sententiæ, nec non GREGORII ACINDYNI, de Haeresibus Palamæ Carmen. 1652. in 4.

III. ORTHODOXAE GRAECIAE Scriptores, IOANNES VECCVS Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus, CONSTANTINVS MELITENIOTA Chartophylax, GREGORIVS METOCHITA Diaconus magnæ Ecclesiæ, MAXIMVS CHRYSOBERGA De Processione Spiritus sancti, & alijs. ad Eminentissimum Cardinalem FLAVIVM GHISIVM S.R.F. Bibliothecarium, Tomus Secundus, LEO ALLATIVS nunc primum e tenebris eruit, & Latine vertit. 1659. in 4.

page.notes: The numeral of the first entry is printed in a larger italic form and is read here as I, marked [?]. The word after "adscito" is read as Græcorum; the scan is faint and it may read Gracorum, marked [?]. The large initial D of entry I is joined to "E ætate". The ornament between the heading and entry I is left out.
